references.text: Describes the Kohathites' responsibility for the holy items in the tabernacle, including the ark, the table, the lampstand, and the altars.
The Kohathites carried the most holy items on their shoulders, not on carts, because their service concerned the Most Holy Place.
Confirms that the sons of Kohath were to carry the holy things after Aaron and his sons had covered them.
Warns that the Kohathites must not look at the uncovered holy items, lest they die.
Describes the Most Holy Place in the tabernacle where the ark of the covenant was placed, the area for which the Kohathites were responsible.
The book of Hebrews refers to the holy items of the tabernacle and the Most Holy Place that the Kohathites were responsible for carrying.
